expectations.text: Addresses color contrast ratios with WCAG AA/AAA standards for healthcare
expectations.evidence: Performed full contrast audit recommending AAA (7:1) for primary content given healthcare context, AA (4.5:1) minimum for all text

expectations.text: Covers screen reader compatibility and ARIA attributes
expectations.evidence: Audit section on screen readers includes ARIA landmark roles, live regions for alerts, form label associations, and reading order verification

expectations.text: Addresses keyboard navigation and focus management
expectations.evidence: Keyboard nav checklist covers tab order, focus trapping in modals, skip-to-content links, and visible focus indicators

expectations.text: Includes elderly-specific considerations (tap targets, text sizing, motor control)
expectations.evidence: Dedicated section for elderly users: 48px minimum tap targets, 16px base font, 200% zoom support, reduced motion preferences

expectations.text: Produces a structured accessibility audit report with prioritized remediation
expectations.evidence: Output includes prioritized audit report with P0 (blocker), P1 (critical), P2 (important) severity levels and specific remediation steps
Covers medical terminology readability, emergency state accessibility, appointment booking flow for assistive tech, and medication dosage display clarity
